intro.text: One of the gangsters at a Bilming warehouse where Wayne and VenDell arrive in disguise.
A member of the Set in Bilming.

items.text: Wayne, posing as Franis, talked Embrier into bringing out the Sequence. As he came back with it, Bilming's city constables flooded into the building.

appearance.text: Stouter, by Wayne's description, than the gang member standing beside him.
